text_sanskrit: पश्यैतां पाण्डुपुत्राणामाचार्य महतीं चमूम् ।व्यूढां द्रुपदपुत्रेण तव शिष्येण धीमता ॥ १-३ ॥
itrans: pashyaitAM pANDuputrANAmAchArya mahatI.n chamUm .vyUDhAM drupadaputreNa tava shiShyeNa dhImatA .. 1-3 ..
translation: Behold this mighty host of the sons of Pandu, O Acharya, which is arrayed by Drupada's son, thy intelligent pupil.
